borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Discord's iOS app is a dark-first community UI built around one load-bearing color: Blurple (`#5865F2`). Open the app and you're dropped into a three-pane architecture — a leftmost server rail of rounded-square server icons, a channel list in the middle, and a message thread on the right — compressed into a mobile form factor via horizontal swipe navigation. The canvas is a near-black gradient of grays: the server rail at `#1E1F22`, the channel list at `#2B2D31`, the chat area at `#313338`. These three adjacent grays are so carefully tuned that they read as sibling surfaces rather than competing panels. The whole app feels like a gaming tool: purpose-built, dense, slightly nerdy, unapologetically dark.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use the three-gray surface system ({#1E1F22} rail → {#2B2D31} list → {#313338} chat) — the adjacency is the brand。
建议：Use Blurple {#5865F2} ONLY as primary accent (CTAs, mentions, active states) — not decoratively。
建议：Render server icons as 48pt rounded squares with 16pt corner radius default, 12pt on active。
建议：Show the 4pt × 40pt white active-indicator bar on the leading edge of the selected server。
建议：Use presence dots (green/yellow/red/gray) on every user avatar — always visible。
dont: 避免：use pure black canvas — Discord's dark is a specific gray system, not {#000000}。
避免：exaggerate the contrast between the three grays — they should feel sibling。
避免：add decorative shadows on messages or server icons — the app is flat。
避免：use Blurple as a body text color — it's structural, not typographic。
避免：use web-accessible icon for channel icons — Discord has proprietary {#} / {🔊} / {📢} glyphs。
